title: Caesar Salad
subtitle: Grilled chicken salad with homemade anchovy dressing and croutons
excerpt: A proper Caesar salad with grilled chicken, homemade croutons, and a sharp anchovy and parmesan dressing. The dressing is made from scratch with egg yolk, anchovies, and lemon. It takes 20 minutes and is far better than anything from a bottle.
sourceNotes: Based on the classic Caesar salad. The dressing technique follows the emulsification method used in the original 1920s Tijuana recipe.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Make the dressing up to 3 days ahead and refrigerate. Make croutons up to 2 days ahead and store in an airtight tin.

content.text: The dressing is the recipe. Make it bold. Anchovies dissolve into it and you will not taste individual fish flavour, just saltiness and depth.

items.prepNote: torn into rough chunks for croutons
3 tbsp for croutons, 3 tbsp for dressing

content.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Toss the bread chunks in 3 tbsp olive oil and a pinch of salt. Spread on a baking tray. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes until golden and crispy. Set aside.
Season the chicken breasts with salt. Cook in a hot dry pan for 5 to 6 minutes each side. Rest for 5 minutes, then slice.
Make the dressing. Put the egg yolk, anchovies, garlic, lemon juice, mustard, and worcestershire sauce in a bowl. Whisk together.
Slowly drizzle in 3 tbsp olive oil while whisking constantly. The dressing should thicken slightly.
Stir in half the parmesan. Taste and adjust salt and lemon.
Put the croutons and sliced chicken in a large bowl. Pour over the dressing. Toss to coat.
Plate up and scatter over the remaining parmesan. Serve at once.

items.cause: Oil added too fast, emulsion did not form
items.fix: Whisk in a drop of cold water to help it thicken.

items.cause: Too many anchovies or anchovies not rinsed
items.fix: Balance with more lemon juice and olive oil.

items.cause: Added too early or dressing pooled at the bottom
